coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Guan's Lemma 1 and Theorems 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 are quoted with their conditions and stay HIGH; Theorem 4 is LOW because the paper does not give its proof. Gonon's theorems are quoted only up to 'there exists theta such that', so their bounds are not quoted and they stay LOW, except Proposition 3.20, whose added term is quoted. Gross's results are derivations in the text. Gutierrez: checked the reader's finding against the printed equations. Eq. 20 gives the QNN response derivative of order Nl to the 3/2, Eq. 21 gives the QRC with N = 2Nl root 2 times that, and both have standard deviation sqrt(Nl), so the printed equations give the QRC the smaller phase uncertainty, by root 2; the Figure 2 ratio of about 1.4 agrees with that. The paper's stated root-2 advantage of the QNN is contradicted by its own equations and figure, and every Gutierrez sensitivity item stays LOW with that cause
